objectives: Explain how the Lord was with Joseph in captivity.
Show that adultery was known sin long before Sinai.
Describe Joseph's example of fleeing from sin.
takeaways: The Lord made all Joseph did to prosper and blessed the Egyptian's house for his sake.
How then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God? Adultery was known as sin from the beginning.
Flee from sin as from the face of a serpent; come too near and it will bite thee. Joseph left his garment and fled.
The woman whose heart is snares and nets: whoso pleaseth God shall escape from her.
In prison the Lord shewed Joseph mercy and favour; the Most High was ordering his steps to save the house of Israel.
